title: Static Cache Allocation Blindness
damaged_code:
```rust
// Hardcoded cache memory size ignoring deployment limits
const DB_BUFFER_POOL_SIZE_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024; // 16GB
```
pattern: Allocating internal cache tables, page pools, or buffer limits using fixed integer constants compiled into the application code.
why_bad: Triggers Out-Of-Memory (OOM) aborts if the binary is deployed to a container or virtual host with fewer resources than the hardcoded ceiling, or severely under-utilizes hardware on high-memory nodes.
detection: Hardcoded memory buffers or resource pool allocations defined using static compiled primitives instead of dynamic metrics.
fix: Detect physical limits dynamically at startup, scaling memory structures proportionally, or resolve limits from standard container configuration targets.
source: Gregg, Brendan - *Systems Performance_ Enterprise and the Cloud* (2013, Pearson Education Limited (US titles)_Prentice Hall).pdf, Chapter 7; Titus Winters, Tom Manshreck, Hyrum Wright - *Software Engineering at Google_ Lessons Learned from Programming Over Time* (2020, O'Reilly Media).pdf, Chapter 23.
